name: What Have They Done To The Rain

podcast.title: Malvina Reynolds Cover, UK Top 20
podcast.body: This song, written by socialist activist Malvina Reynolds to oppose nuclear weapons testing, was learned by Chris Curtis from a Joan Baez album. It was The Searchers' first folk song released as a single and, despite its departure from their normal style and controversial subject matter, achieved a Top 20 position. "Even though it wasn't as big a success as some of their other hits, given how utterly different it was from their normal style and how controversial the subject was, getting it into the top 20 at all seems quite an achievement."
